newsitem.title: CANADA: Great-West bids for London Insurance.
newsitem.headline: Great-West bids for London Insurance.

text.p: Great-West Lifeco Inc said Tuesday it would make an offer of C$33.50 per share, or C$2.9 billion, for all outstanding common shares of London Insurance Group.

If successful, the deal would result in the establishment of the largest insurance group in Canada, with total assets of C$52.8 billion, total revenues of C$11.6 billion, and 3,600 sales representatives, Great-West said in a statement.
Canada's largest bank, Royal Bank of Canada, in June made a C$2.4 billion bid for London Insurance.

Great-West said shareholders of London Insurance will have the option of receiving the C$33.50 per share payment in cash, in common shares of Great-West, in a combination of cash and common shares of Great-West, in a combination of cash, common and preferred shares of Great-West, or in a combination of cash, common shares of Great-West and preferred shares of Great-West Life Assurance Co, a unit of Great-West.
Investors Group Inc will participate in the deal by acquiring eight to 10 percent of Great-West common equity, Great-West said.
